preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 1 and 123456.
The number of attacked cities m must be between 1 and n.
The number of roads must be exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: All cities connected by roads must be valid city numbers.

preconditions.expression: len(attacked_cities) == m and all(1 <= city <= n for city in attacked_cities)
preconditions.description: The attacked cities must be distinct and valid city numbers.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the optimal city number and the minimum time needed to scare all humans.

postconditions.expression: optimal_city in attacked_cities or optimal_city in set(range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The optimal city must be either an attacked city or a valid city number.
The minimum time must be non-negative.
